headline: Weathered Expanse Rekindles Amid Mooring County Fury
war_summary: Since the morning edition the fighting wires have quickened markedly, with the Weathered Expanse returning to the head of the list at thirteen changes in two hours and fifty-seven in the day about Crow's Nest, Wightwalk and Huntsfort, now standing three Warden, three Colonial and three ruined with some 7,180 Colonial and 7,130 Warden casualties in the day. Mooring County follows close at nine changes in two hours and fifty-three in the day about the Wind Hills, Wiccwalk and Gravekeeper's Holdfast, now five Warden, six Colonial and one ruined after very heavy losses near 19,185 Colonial and 16,747 Warden. Linn Mercy reports eight changes in two hours and forty-two in the day about Outwich Ranch, Lathair and Rotdust at two Warden, seven Colonial and two ruined. Callum's Cape shows two changes in two hours and nineteen in the day about Lookout, Naofa and Callum's Keep at one Warden, five Colonial and one ruined amid the heaviest day toll of 17,202 Colonial and 15,832 Warden casualties. Marban Hollow is quiet at none in two hours and twelve in the day centered on Checkpoint Bua at four Warden, three Colonial and one ruined, while Callahan's Passage and the Deadlands still show no changes despite continued casualties.
